text:
marco_csm: Drafting a 1-page ops checklist CSMs can hand to new accounts before demo. Aim: reduce renewal risk by standardizing warm pools, prefill cadence, delta-sync, cache TTLs, and streaming fallbacks.
jess_eng: Make it copy-paste. Two tiny examples: a 3-line prefill job and a curl to enable streaming.
oliver_sre: Add SLO rule: if interactive p50 >300ms, reduce batch size or enable prefix-KV cache; if avg latency climbs +20% over baseline, escalate.
marco_csm: Checklist draft: (A) Health snapshot (owner: CSM) (B) Run prefill 24h before launch (owner: Eng) (C) Warm pool on (owner: SRE) (D) Delta-sync 5-10m windows (owner: CSM) (E) Feedback hook after 5 live requests (owner: CSM).
jess_eng: Example prefill (3 lines):
```yaml
job: prefill_v1
requests: prompt_set: tenant_warmup
cache_ttl: 86400
```
jess_eng: Curl to turn on streaming: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/sessions/stream -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"stream":true,"keepalive":30}'`
oliver_sre: Fallbacks: return cached response if generation >1.2s or route to smaller model. Escalation: renewal-risk>0.7 + latency up -> 30-min triage ENG+SRE+CSM.
ops-bot: Reminder: post final checklist to #customer-success-docs in 24h.
